fold_rule: first eight SHA256 bytes of example_id modulo 3
query_action_rule: Select maximum OOF action score, tie by delayed sentence index; otherwise STAY
primary_gate: At frozen 10% query budget: >=3 safe Complete repairs, <=1 Complete break, net Complete >=2, cumulative context no greater than V8, and repairs occur in >=2 held-out folds
